_comment: Thanksgiving collection: 'Harvest' forms. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed thanksgiving-2026` (random lines no other collection uses).

readme.title: Thanksgiving (Harvest)
readme.summary: Pokemon dressed for a Thanksgiving table.
looks: colours moved onto a harvest palette: cranberry, peach, pumpkin, maize gold, sage, chestnut, plum
greys, whites and blacks become pie-crust cream, cinnamon and dark roast
a golden-brown roast glaze along the edges and a few fallen maple leaves
eyes keep their original colours; glowing parts glow like candlelight
shiny: golden harvest, everything pulled toward honey-gold
